_doc: item Profile 8 40x40 light (0.0.026.33): 40 x 40 mm, Line 8, the light shape, natural anodised. Dimensions and section figures are item's product data sheet; the groove is item's table of groove dimensions. The drawn outline leaves out the hollow behind each lip of the light groove, the rounded mouths and the rounds in the hollows, so it comes out 5 to 8% heavier than item's figures and about 10% stiffer in bending: a beam should use the sheet's figures.
